_comment: Copy to thermo_config.json (gitignored) and fill in. device_id and local_key come from `python -m tinytuya wizard`. The local key is a secret, and re-pairing the controller in Smart Life changes it. Give it inline or move it to the environment with "local_key_env": "INKBIRD_LOCAL_KEY".

location._comment: Where the tub is, for the outdoor temperature (Open-Meteo, no key needed).
